action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access (no port, empty, 0, 65535, 65536, negative, noninteger, non-ASCII digits) for both urlsplit and urlparse with text and byte URLs. Assert exception class, args, message for invalid ports; assert concrete results for valid boundary cases. Also add documentation with executable examples. Files: Lib/test/test_urlparse.py, Doc/library/urllib.parse.rst. Implementation: Lib/urllib/parse.py. Current candidate: 2921cbc8a115c86871a11f8eaea929c3d48a8e4d2bb2ca03bf48971c36cf15cd. Tests run after test edits; public runs after doc edits.
